command_line:
set -eu
mkdir -p pylocal
pip install --no-cache-dir --target=pylocal statsmodels
cat > job.py << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "pylocal")
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

data = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1], sep="\t")
data = data[data["Efficacy"].isin(["PR", "SD", "PD"])]
data = data.dropna(subset=["BMI"])
data["responder"] = (data["Efficacy"] == "PR").astype(int)

X = sm.add_constant(data["BMI"].astype(float))
y = data["responder"]

model = sm.Logit(y, X)
result = model.fit(disp=False)

with open("aic_result.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(str(result.aic))
ENDOFSCRIPT
